scores.comment: Strength: the brief gets the KPI exactly right (2 or more non-cancelled orders within 12 months of the first order, grouped by first-order year). It also sees that 2026 cannot be measured and is honest about what the data cannot explain. Gap: the analyst never asked about breakdowns, so the US vs international split by country is missing and is replaced by a long list of unrequested dimensions. The business question also assumes there was a drop, when the stakeholder wants to hear if there wasn't one. And the brief contradicts itself on whether the 2025 group is complete: Q3 and the KPI text say it is, while the assumptions propose limiting it to Jan–Sep first orders.
